content: Tikwikame Wetetsita mayekatei
Merikɨtsɨ 'arike mɨyatiuyɨku huriyutsixi wa'ixɨarari kanaye'ani, Ketsutsi Kerutsareme kaneutiyune.

Kerutsareme haa mana kaniyemakaitɨni Muxatsi Wakitenie hehurakaku, hepɨrayutsixi waniukikɨ Wetetsita katiniuyetewakaitɨni haa mayemakai, 'auxɨwitɨ kitenie waritana pawetɨkatei 'etɨpiwari hexeiyatɨkaitɨ.
Mɨkɨ kiteniete 'etɨpiwariyari hetɨa mekanayeheteitɨni yumɨiretɨ tekwikwikate, memɨkaheuneniere, memɨhurietɨka, memɨmamawawaki, meta'ikwewatɨ haa mɨkuyuitɨarienikɨ.
Heiwa mana kaniuta'axekaitɨni niuki tuayame, haa kanikuyuitɨwakaitɨni, kemɨ'ane meri mana meuweni haa kuyuitɨarieyu yukuiniya kaniku'itiyarɨwakaitɨni tsepa ketitakɨ mɨtikuyekai.
Merikɨtsɨ xewitɨ tewi mana kanayekateitɨni xeitewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahaika wiyari mɨtikuyekai.
Ketsutsi 'ixeiyaka mana 'ukaikame, heitimaika mɨixa mɨyuriekaikɨ, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —¿Peti'awaɨriya 'aixɨa pereu'erietɨ pemayanikɨ?
Tikwikame mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Neuxei Ti'aitame, netsiparewiwame nepɨkahexeiya hapa mɨnetsiheukahɨanikɨ kepauka haa mukuyuitɨarienitsie, mana ne'ukamiekaku xewitɨ meri mana kaneuwautseni.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kenanukukexi, 'a'itari kenanukukwe'i, kenekuyeikani.
Yapauka tewi 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ kanayani, hikɨ yu'itari kananukukweni, kuyeikatɨ kanayani. Merikɨtsɨ 'ana tukaritsie 'uxipiya tukari kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.
'Ayumieme huriyutsixi mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ mayeitɨarie: —Hikɨ 'uxipiya tukari kanihɨkɨtɨni, heitserie pepɨkahexeiya 'a'itari pemanukukwenikɨ.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Kemɨ'ane 'aixɨa nereu'eriekame mɨnetsi'ayeitɨa, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kanetinetahɨawe: “'A'itari kenanukukwe'i, kenekuyeikani”.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenita'iwawiya: —¿Kepaikɨ pɨhɨkɨ mɨkɨ tewi mɨya mɨmetiutahɨawixɨ: “'A'itari kenanukukwe'i, kenekuyeikani”?
'Aixɨa reu'erietɨ mayeitɨarie 'atsipɨkatimaikai kemɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨtɨkai, Ketsutsi metɨakɨ yumɨiretɨ mana me'u'uwakaku watsata.
Hikɨ 'arikeke Ketsutsi kanitaxeiya tuki kuraruyarita, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kamɨ, 'aixɨa pereu'erietɨ pekanayaniri. Tawariri 'axapepɨkareyurieneni kapa waɨkawa pe'u'itɨarienikɨ matsi.
Tewi kaneyani, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe huriyutsixi kename Ketsutsi hɨkɨtɨkai kemɨ'ane 'aixɨa reu'eriekame meyeitɨa.
'Ayumieme huriyutsixi mekaniweiyakaitɨni Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ mɨtiyurienekaikɨ 'uxipiya tukaritsie.
Peru Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwakɨhɨawekaitɨni: —Ne'ukiyari hikɨ mɨyakatini'uximayaka, neta 'ayumieme yanekatini'uximayaka.

'Ayumieme matsi kwinimieme mekanikuwautɨwekaitɨni huriyutsixi me'imienike, 'uxipiya tukari 'inɨariyari mɨtitsanakaikɨ xeikɨa hawaikɨ, matsitsɨ 'akuxi Kakaɨyari mɨxatakaikɨ yu'ukiyaritɨme, Kakaɨyari hepaɨ 'anetɨ 'ayuyeitɨwatɨ.
Kakaɨyari Nu'aya heitserie kemɨrexeiya

Hikɨ 'ayumieme Ketsutsi heitseriemekɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, nu'aya 'atsimɨtiuyurieni pɨkayɨwe yɨkɨmana, kemɨtixeiya yu'ukiyari yatiyurieneme xeikɨa pɨyɨwe. Tita 'ukiyarieya mɨtiyuriene, mɨpaɨta katiniyurieneni nu'aya.

Ne'ukiyari yuniwe pɨnaki'erie. Naime katinixeiyatsitɨani kemɨtiyuriene mɨkɨ. 'Ikɨ kemɨtiyuriene 'etsiwa mariwemekɨ xeikɨa, matsi yemekɨ kanixeiyatsitɨamɨkɨ waɨkawa mamariwawemekɨ, xemɨhɨxiyanikɨ xeme.
Ne'ukiyari mɨkite mɨtiwaranuku'uitɨwa hepaɨ, tukari mɨtiwarupitɨwa hepaɨ nu'ayata mɨpaɨ tukari pɨtiwakupitɨwa kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ mɨwareupitɨamɨkɨ.
Mɨkɨ meta, ne'ukiyari xeime heitserie pɨkapitɨani 'itsɨkame hepaɨ, matsi heitserie kanipitɨani yuniwe 'itsɨkame hepaɨ naime 'aixɨa mɨtiyurienikɨ,
yunaitɨ 'aixɨa memɨtehehɨawenikɨ nu'aya, yaxeikɨa 'aixɨa kememɨtehahɨawe hepaɨ 'ukiyarieya yuniwe meyenɨ'a. Kemɨ'ane nu'aya 'aixɨa mɨkarahɨawe, mɨkɨ 'ukiyarieyata 'aixɨa pɨkarahɨawe meiyenɨ'a.

»Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, kemɨ'ane neniuki mɨ'enie, yuri ti'eririetɨ 'iya mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a, mɨkɨ tukari mɨkaxɨwe kanexeiyani. 'Itsɨkame hɨxie pɨkatakwewiyaniri, matsi kaniuyupatari, kemɨtimɨkikai, 'ayenieretɨri pɨta kanayani.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nekanaineni, tukari kanaye'amɨkɨ, hikɨ kanaye'aniri, kepauka mɨkite memi'enieni Kakaɨyari Nu'aya 'utaniukame. Mɨkɨ memɨ'enanani mekanayenenierekakuni.
Ne'ukiyari yɨkɨmana tukari kemɨrexeiya, mɨpaɨ yaxeikɨa katinipitɨani yuniwe tukari mexeiyanikɨ yɨkɨmana.
Heitserie kanipitɨanita 'itsɨkame hepaɨ 'aixɨa mɨtiyurienikɨ Yuri Tewi mɨhɨkɨkɨ.
»Xepɨkahɨxiyaka 'ikɨkɨ, tukari kanaye'amɨkɨ kepauka yunaitɨ memukateukie memi'enieni 'iya 'utaniukame,
meta mepɨwatikɨne. Mɨkɨ 'aixɨa memɨteyuriekai mekananuku'uikuni tukari memɨpitɨarienikɨ, peru 'axamemɨteyuriekaita mete'anuku'uni memanutaxɨriyanikɨ.

Ne nekɨmana 'atsinepɨkatiyɨwe, kenemɨti'ena, mɨpaɨ heitserie nepɨtiyuriene 'itsɨkame hepaɨ neyɨanetɨ, kemɨtiheitseriekɨ nepɨwayuriene nemɨka'ikuwaunekɨ tita mɨnetinake ne, tita mɨtinake 'iya mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a pɨta nemɨkuwaunekɨ.
Kememɨte'ihekɨata Kɨritsitu
»Ne xɨka nehepaɨtsita netihekɨatanike, yurikɨ nepɨkatihekɨatanikeyu.
Xewitɨ 'akaniuyeikani mɨtihekɨata nehepaɨtsita, nekatinimaika mɨkɨ yuri mɨtihekɨatakɨ nehepaɨtsita kemɨtihekɨata.
»Xeme Wani hetsɨa xekaniwarenɨ'ani memita'iwawiyakɨ, mɨkɨ tita yuri mɨraine hepaɨtsita katiniutahekɨata.
Ne matsi nepɨka'itanaki'eri tita teɨteri memɨtehekɨata nehepaɨtsita, perutsɨ 'ipaɨ nekaniutaineni xemɨtawikweitsitɨarienikɨ xeme.
Wani kɨxeme kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni tatɨ hekɨariwietɨ. Xeme xekaniyuwaɨriyakaitɨni xemɨyutemamawiekakɨ mɨkɨ yatixehekɨariwiyakaku yapaɨmexɨa.

»Ne matsi waɨkawa nekatinihekɨatani Wani 'etsiwa xeikɨa tihekɨatakaku. Tita nemɨtiyuriene, ne'ukiyari kemɨnetiupitɨa nemeye'atɨanikɨ, 'ikɨ 'uximayatsika kenemɨtiyuriene, 'ikɨ nehepaɨtsita katinihekɨatani kename ne'ukiyari netsiheyenɨ'a.
Mɨkɨrita ne'ukiyari mɨnetsiheyenɨ'a, mɨkɨtɨtɨ nehepaɨtsita katinihekɨatani. Xeme hatsuaku xepɨka'i'eniewawe 'utaniukame, meta xepɨka'ixeiyawawe kemɨtiyuxexeiya.
Niukieya xepɨkahexeiya yuhetsie yuri xemɨkate'i'eririekɨ kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ meyenɨ'atsie.
Xeme 'utɨarikatsie xepɨtekuwautɨwe xeyukweriwayurietɨ, mɨpaɨ xemɨteku'eriwakɨ kename mɨkɨkɨ tukari mɨkaxɨwe xehexeiyatɨ xe'akɨne. Mɨkɨtɨtɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni tita nehepaɨtsita mɨtihekɨata.
Peru xepɨkayuwaɨriya nehepa xemakɨnekɨ tukari xemexeiyanikɨ.
»Tita teɨteri memɨtexata witsimenetexeiyatɨ, mɨkɨ nepɨkanaki'erie.
Matsi nepɨxehetima xeme, Kakaɨyari heitseriekamekɨ xemɨkanaki'eriekɨ.
Ne nekaninuani ne'ukiyari hetsɨa nemiemetɨtɨ. Xemeri xepɨkanetsi'utanaki'eri. Xɨka xewitɨ pɨta nuani yuhetsɨa mieme tikuxatatɨ, mɨkɨ xekanitanaki'erikuni.
¿Kexeteyɨwawe yuri xemɨteta'erienikɨ xɨka xe'itanaki'erieni tita xemɨtexata witsixeteyuxeiyatɨ, xɨkarita xekatekuwautɨweni 'iya muyuxewi Kakaɨyaritɨtɨ witsimɨtixexeiyanikɨ xeme?
»Mɨpaɨ xepɨkateku'eriwani kename nexetaxaneta ne'ukiyari hɨxie. Xewitɨ 'akaniuyeikani mɨxexaneta. Muitsexi kanihɨkɨtɨni, kemɨ'ane hetsie yuri xemɨte'erie.
Xɨkatsɨ yuri xete'eriekake Muitsexi hetsie, nehetsieta yuri xepɨte'eriekake, mɨkɨ nehepaɨtsita mɨraka'utɨakɨ.
Xɨka mɨkɨ 'utɨarikayatsie yuri xekate'erieka, ¿keri yuri xeteta'erieni tita nemɨtikuxatatsie?»
